title: Snail holding a heart
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- Ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="84" rx="38" ry="6" fill="#7ec8e3" opacity="0.4"/>

  <!-- Snail body / foot -->
  <path d="M12 78 Q10 72 20 70 L72 70 Q84 70 84 78 Q84 84 72 84 L20 84 Q10 84 12 78 Z" fill="#f4a460"/>
  <path d="M12 78 Q10 72 20 70 L72 70 Q80 70 82 74 Q72 72 20 74 Q12 74 12 78 Z" fill="#ffd8a8"/>

  <!-- Snail head -->
  <circle cx="78" cy="66" r="11" fill="#f4a460"/>
  <circle cx="78" cy="66" r="11" fill="#ffb56b" opacity="0.4"/>

  <!-- Eye stalks -->
  <line x1="74" y1="58" x2="70" y2="44" stroke="#f4a460" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="82" y1="58" x2="86" y2="44" stroke="#f4a460" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx="70" cy="44" r="4" fill="#ffe0b2"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="43" r="2" fill="#5a3e2b"/>
  <circle cx="69.3" cy="42.3" r="0.7" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <circle cx="86" cy="44" r="4" fill="#ffe0b2"/>
  <circle cx="86" cy="43" r="2" fill="#5a3e2b"/>
  <circle cx="85.3" cy="42.3" r="0.7" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <!-- Snail shell -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="60" r="22" fill="#e8732c"/>
  <circle cx="42" cy="60" r="22" fill="#ff8c42" opacity="0.35"/>
  <path d="M42 60 m-4 0 a4 4 0 1 1 8 0 a8 8 0 1 1 -16 0 a12 12 0 1 1 24 0 a16 16 0 1 1 -32 0" fill="none" stroke="#ffc078" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="42" cy="60" r="3" fill="#c05a1a"/>

  <!-- Shell highlight -->
  <path d="M32 48 Q36 42 44 43" fill="none" stroke="#ffd8a8" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- Heart held by snail (in front of shell/head) -->
  <g transform="translate(62, 74)">
    <path d="M0 8 C-10 -4 -22 2 -14 12 L0 22 L14 12 C22 2 10 -4 0 8 Z" fill="#ff4d6d"/>
    <path d="M-2 8 C-10 0 -18 3 -12 10 L0 18" fill="none" stroke="#ff8fa3" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.8"/>
    <circle cx="-5" cy="6" r="2" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.6"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Snail arm holding heart -->
  <path d="M70 72 Q68 76 66 74" stroke="#f4a460" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
</svg>
